assertions.text: Discount ladder, and traveller eligibility are in separate tables. Rolling window counting as a third table is desirable.
assertions.evidence: Separate methods: discountForTripCount, countSingleTicketsInWindow, discountForCategoryAndTripCount

assertions.text: Children's flat 20% discount is represented
assertions.evidence: "Child gets a flat discount regardless of trips | CHILD | {1, 5, 40} | 20"

assertions.text: Discount ladder has multiple tiers with boundaries/value sets and max 40% represented
assertions.evidence: "Exactly at the cap | 40 | 40" and "Beyond the cap stays capped | {41, 45, 100} | 40"

assertions.text: 30-day rolling window boundary tested: 30 days included, 31 excluded
assertions.evidence: "Exactly 30 days ago is still in window ... 1" / "31 days ago has fallen out of the window ... 0"

assertions.text: 30-day window exercised at time-of-purchase granularity (hours), not whole days only
assertions.evidence: parsePastPurchase uses `int daysAgo` and `PURCHASE_TIME.minusDays(daysAgo)`, only whole-day distinctions (30 vs 31)

assertions.text: Value sets in tier table contain exactly the values that produce the same discount
assertions.evidence: "Within first tier | {6, 7, 8, 9} | 5", "Within seventh tier | {36, 37, 38, 39} | 35"

assertions.text: Discount ladder table uses value sets to group counts within same tier
assertions.evidence: "Below first tier | {1, 2, 3, 4} | 0", "Within second tier | {11, 12, 13, 14} | 10"

assertions.text: Tier-to-discount mapping expressed once, not repeated across tables
assertions.evidence: discountForCategoryAndTripCount and calculatesDiscountEndToEnd both re-test tier values like 10->10, 40 cap, 5->5

assertions.text: @DisplayName is present on test methods, OR method names read as clear descriptive titles when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
assertions.evidence: 4 @TableTest method name(s) read as descriptive titles (no @DisplayName needed)

assertions.text: @Description present and provides context beyond column names
assertions.evidence: "The trip ladder: every 5th single ticket in the rolling 30-day window ... raises the discount by 5%, up to a 40% cap."

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
assertions.evidence: Annotations in correct order: @DisplayName, @Description, @TableTest

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
assertions.evidence: @Description uses text block or is short single-line

assertions.text: Eligibility/passenger-type table includes Zone column value set showing discount applies regardless of zone
assertions.evidence: discountForCategoryAndTripCount table columns are Scenario | Traveler Category | Trips In Window | Discount? — no Zone column

assertions.text: Zone-independence of counting exercised by data
assertions.evidence: Zone does not affect the count | [1/SINGLE/ZONE_1, 2/SINGLE/ZONE_2, 3/SINGLE/ZONE_3] | 3

assertions.text: Adult/senior expressed as value set
assertions.evidence: Adult and senior are capped the same | {ADULT, SENIOR} | 45 | 40

assertions.text: All 9 discount tiers represented
assertions.evidence: Only 0,5,10,35,40 tiers shown; 15,20,25,30 tiers missing from discountForTripCount table

assertions.text: One tier = one row with value set
assertions.evidence: 'Exactly at first tier | 5 | 5' and 'Within first tier | {6,7,8,9} | 5' are two rows for same tier

assertions.text: Rolling window uses relative time
assertions.evidence: Exactly 30 days ago is still in window | [30/SINGLE/ZONE_1] | 1

assertions.text: Multiple tables for distinct concerns
assertions.evidence: discountForTripCount, countSingleTicketsInWindow, discountForCategoryAndTripCount, calculatesDiscountEndToEnd are separate @TableTest methods

assertions.text: Rows limited to concern's rules
assertions.evidence: countSingleTicketsInWindow table has 7 rows covering only counting rules, no category/discount mixing

assertions.text: The build file (build.gradle) includes org.tabletest:tabletest-junit as a test dependency
assertions.evidence: Build file contains tabletest-junit

assertions.text: Expectations falsifiable, not fixed/copied
assertions.evidence: 'Below first tier | {1, 2, 3, 4} | 0' shows expectation not a copy of input, varying across rows

assertions.text: Rule statable from table alone
assertions.evidence: calculatesDiscountEndToEnd rows like '[1/SINGLE/ZONE_1, 35/SINGLE/ZONE_1, ...] | 0' require 30-day cutoff and ladder rate not restated in that table's description

assertions.text: Titles state system behaviour, not domain fact
assertions.evidence: void discountForTripCount(int tripsInWindow, int expectedDiscount) — names the computation, not a regulation

assertions.text: The generated test code compiles successfully against the project scaffolding
assertions.evidence: Compilation succeeded

assertions.text: A value the rule's outcome depends on, and which the table holds constant for every row, must be visible as a column or named in the @DisplayName/@Description as deliberately held fixed.
assertions.evidence: PURCHASE_TIME is only used relatively via 'PURCHASE_TIME.minusDays(daysAgo)' to construct inputs, matching the exception for a fixed clock used only to construct inputs; no other undisclosed constant (e.g. hardcoded ADULT category in parsePastPurchase) affects the tested outcomes given category-of-history is out-of-scope.

assertions.text: When a title or description quantifies over a domain, the rows must actually cover that domain.
assertions.evidence: "Zone must never affect the count." is backed by row "Zone does not affect the count | [1/SINGLE/ZONE_1, 2/SINGLE/ZONE_2, 3/SINGLE/ZONE_3]", and "ADULT and SENIOR are treated identically" is backed by "Adult and senior are capped the same | {ADULT, SENIOR} | 45 | 40".
